archetypes.name: dyn-ruff-tightening
archetypes.rationale: Review whether per-file complexity ignores now match regenerated live baseline paths exactly.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on python/ruff.toml and python/complexity-baseline.json. Verify that removed complexity suppressions correspond to absent live baseline rows, and that path-qualified replacements for shared basenames do not leave cleaned files suppressed. Check that non-complexity suppressions and test-facing exemptions were preserved. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
